# Recipient scope. Creates the artifact of the type picked by scope:ucm_craft_player.
ucm_craft_create_by_type_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 1 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_axe_name TYPE = axe VISUALS = axe }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 2 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_dagger_name TYPE = dagger VISUALS = dagger }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 3 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_hammer_name TYPE = hammer VISUALS = hammer }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 4 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_mace_name TYPE = mace VISUALS = mace }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 5 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_spear_name TYPE = spear VISUALS = spear }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 6 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_sword_name TYPE = sword VISUALS = sword }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 7 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_sword_name TYPE = sword VISUALS = longsword }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 8 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_sword_name TYPE = sword VISUALS = sassanian_sword }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 9 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_bow_name TYPE = bow VISUALS = bow }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 10 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_longbow_name TYPE = longbow VISUALS = longbow }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { scope:ucm_craft_player = { var:ucm_craft_type = 11 } }
    ucm_craft_make_artifact_effect = { NAME = artifact_composite_name TYPE = composite VISUALS = composite }
